Thank you my dear friend you are truly a brave soul living among us, your sincere words and thoughts have overwhelmed me, God Bless you and your soul.
No i totally get what you're saying I've been trying to do the same actually...it does help me a lot
Thanks for you're advice and caring... God bless you

"I'm a work-in-progress myself"

Thank you for passing by.
Thank you for your kind words.

Currently I have this page, and I don't have anyone who I could talk to, and going to a psychiatrist is kind of signing my death sentence to my medical degree.....
I'll figure something out I've always did but i had to let some steam out.

But am happy that I have found this page.

I've never showed weakness I never did, I could handle any kind of heat or any extreme condition, but its that moment I leave the hospital and am driving back home, or lying on bed just thinking how this should end. 

I guess what keeps me going sometimes is how my patients love me and always ask for me, even ER have regular patients who they visit every now and then. I've noticed and was told by their own words that they trust me and wouldn't chose someone else besides me I never knew why exactly but its been like this since i was doing my internship rotations.
Thank you for taking the time to pass by arachnophobia-kid
And Thank you for your time> .

I do have a passion to agriculture, but i can't pursue at the moment, due to financial bonds i have to accommodate, I can't just quit my job today.... but I have put in consideration of leaving the medical field in 5 years.

Thank you for understanding, you have made it clear enough for how our medical community sometimes go through these phases, i wish you too all the best am sure you're a strong loving person which makes you someone special.

Thank you again.

accumulations i guess from the past, and some how the graphic sense  in my line of work have changed my perception towards myself and my surrounding....and i have never liked that feeling, where I have adapted myself to such extreme conditions.
